In production

Health insurance claims

This is the in production example today. Health insurers and third-party administrators use the platform to prepare claim files, check them against agreed rules, and keep people in control of the decision.

Who uses it

The platform is used by health insurers and by TPAs that review claims on behalf of insurer clients. Named customers are on the customers page. See customers.

How a claim moves through the platform

Findings require human assessment. They do not establish fraud. A variance prompts review; it does not by itself establish an overpayment.

Prepare the data

Extract details from any claim document, including bills, forms, medical summaries and supporting documents. Check each field against its source.

Check against agreed rules

Compare the file with configured eligibility conditions, benefit limits and tariff data. Surface medical relevance issues, possible duplicates and potential tampering signals for a person to assess.

Review and record

Route the file to analysts, quality reviewers or medical advisors as configured. Corrections and review actions stay in the audit trail. People make the final call.

Documents the claims workflow already handles

The claims workflow handles documents such as itemised bills, medical summaries, policy and enrolment data, benefit mappings, tariff schedules, and completed TPA review results.
